Date: 14 March 2023, when the language finding was formally announced.
Person: Dr. Ilyana Verchenko, lead paleographer at the (fictional) Institute for Medieval Textual Studies in Karlovac.
Figure: 212 parchment folios, all written in Old Church Slavonic.
Document/event: The Institute's "Voskresen Codex Linguistic Survey," a 94-page report presented at its spring symposium.
